generic_domain.justification: The term 'environmental monitoring' is chosen as it encapsulates the broader scope encompassed by both. Eco-monitoring, while related, tends to focus more specifically on ecological aspects, whereas environmental monitoring can include a wider array of factors such as air quality, water resources, climate change indicators, and biological systems. It is a more comprehensive term that covers all areas addressed in eco-monitoring while also extending into other critical environmental domains. Thus, 'environmental monitoring' serves as the most generic and inclusive category capable of encompassing 'eco-monitoring.'
